title: vLLM v0.31.0 block_pool.py free_blocks
quote: # FIFO reuse of cached blocks for LRU eviction behavior.
proves: GPU prefix-cache eviction is implicit LRU via free-queue order: hashed blocks appended to tail, unhashed blocks prepended (LIFO) so they are reused first; no frequency or cost signal
does_not_prove: Does not show hit-rate cost of LRU on any workload; no policy hook exists to swap
bearing: supports: eviction-policy swap is a local one-function edit on our stack

title: vLLM v0.31.0 kv_cache_utils.py FreeKVCacheBlockQueue
quote: Note that we maintain this order by reversing the block order when free blocks of a request.
proves: Free queue is an intrusive doubly linked list ordered LRU-first, with chain-tail blocks evicted before chain-head blocks of the same request (free in reverse, single_type_kv_cache_manager.py:589)
does_not_prove: Says nothing about whether tail-first is optimal for multi-turn or branching workloads
bearing: supports: block-order/eviction experiments; threatens nothing

title: vLLM v0.31.0 config/cache.py CacheConfig defaults
quote: prefix_caching_hash_algo: PrefixCachingHashAlgo = "sha256"
proves: Defaults: block_size 16 (DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE), enable_prefix_caching True, hash sha256 over pickle (options sha256, sha256_cbor, xxhash, xxhash_cbor), gpu_memory_utilization 0.92, cache_dtype auto, kv_offloading_size None
does_not_prove: Defaults are not measured choices; no evidence here on hash cost or block-size optimum
bearing: supports: block-size and hash-algo sweeps are flag-only

title: vLLM v0.31.0 scheduler.py preemption
quote: preempted_req = self.running[-1]
proves: FCFS victim is the last-admitted running request (PRIORITY: max priority, arrival_time); _preempt_request (L1538) frees all blocks and sets num_computed_tokens = 0: recompute only, no swap in V1
does_not_prove: Does not quantify wasted recompute; resumed request may still re-hit its own freed blocks via prefix cache if not yet evicted
bearing: supports: preemption victim / partial-retention ideas; see E20, E21 for scoop

quote: KERNEL_BLOCK_SIZES = (32, 16, 8)
